title: recovery-markers
description: The markers of the recovery cycle of one phase, written by the engine and removed at the approval of the phase. Feature 101 (T002); the field list is the table "Recovery markers" of specs/101-gate-and-verdict/data-model.md, and the specification stands where the two differ.

phase.description: The phase the markers belong to

diagnosed.description: The signature for which the diagnostician ran last; written after every call. Null before the first call

accelerated.description: The signature for which an accelerated phase attempt started last; written before its pass. Null before the first one
